implementations.name: pda
implementations.notes: Drives src/poppy directly (PoppyClient, sign-in, conversations, APIs, operations) in Node; no model.

implementations.name: lenient-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The pda image with the lenient profile (interop/impls/pda-agent/profiles.ts): accepts every reading of what a Company does that gives no more access, such as server metadata at either S3 location and another of the Company's names as a client assertion aud after invalid_client. The reference agent for attribution rule 2. Sends what pda sends, so it may run in the live lane.

implementations.name: strict-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The pda image with the strict profile: runs the runner's Company-side checks and the validator over everything it receives, refuses at the first finding of any level (a SHOULD or the Guides included), and serves its findings at GET /violations: in the live lane, which records nothing, the only checks a cell gets.

implementations.name: sloppy-personal-agent
implementations.notes: The pda image with the sloppy profile: the mistakes real agents make, declared honestly: assertions without typ that live 300 s (S2 lenient-300s), a token-endpoint aud everywhere (S1 token-endpoint). Honest, not adversarial. Never in the live lane ("live": false): its departures are deliberate.

implementations.name: lenient-company
implementations.notes: The mock Company from test/mock-company with its S2-lenient settings (strictAssertions off), the reference Company for attribution rule 2. Serves its recorded violations at GET /violations.

implementations.name: strict-company
implementations.notes: The same image as lenient-company with the mock's strict profile: assertion typ "JWT", a kid naming a published key and a 60-second lifetime (S2 jwt-60s), as the strictest live Companies require.

implementations.name: evil-company
implementations.notes: The adversarial Company: the lenient-company image with INTEROP_ADVERSARY=company, reconfigured per attack by the arm hook. Runs only against our own owner:self agent, never in the live lane (docs/adversarial-interop.md; SECURITY.md).
